justifications.type_expressiveness: Discrete states are modeled as enums (Expr, Value, UnaryOp, BinaryOp, EvalError variants) but TypeError carries a String payload rather than a structured variant capturing operator and operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Typed EvalError with three meaningful variants and ParseError with offset, uses Result throughout and avoids panics in normal paths, but relies on String messages and unreachable!() rather than restructured matches.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Public types have sensible derives and Display/Debug impls, but there are no doc comments on any public item and the manual Debug impls duplicate what derive would provide.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ? usage, derives, and clean recursive descent, though it uses index-based byte loops in the lexer and some clone-heavy patterns where borrowing or matches!/iterator chains would read more naturally.
